misconception: Each source of Invaders adds its own Explorer: a land next to two Town/City lands, or containing a Town, gets one Explorer per source.
rulebook: p10 "No matter how many sources are in or adjacent to an Explored land, you only add one Explorer."

edits.find:
explore-step, invader-card:explore C, card:terrain C T, land:terrain L T, explorable L
  ~explore L
edits.replace:
explore-step, invader-card:explore C, card:terrain C T, land:terrain L T, explore-source L, at P L, piece:kind P town
  ~explore L
explore-step, invader-card:explore C, card:terrain C T, land:terrain L T, adjacent L L2, explore-source L2
  ~explore L L2
explore L Src, ~add-piece L explorer

notes: Sources are counted per land (own Towns, each adjacent source land), so l3 in the scenario gets 2.
